levels.title: Harbour Friends
levels.subtitle: Welcome Harbour · Hello
levels.story: A new friend is waiting to say hello!
levels.hello: Hello! Welcome to the harbour! Can you find the friend who says hello?
levels.outcome: Our new friends are ready for the journey!

levels.title: Find the Bus
levels.subtitle: Welcome Harbour · Hello
levels.story: Which bus should we take? Listen carefully!
levels.hello: Great! Now listen and find the bus I say.
levels.outcome: We found our buses. Next stop: the boat!

levels.title: All Aboard
levels.subtitle: Welcome Harbour · Hello
levels.story: One last listening game, then we sail!
levels.hello: Well done! Now find what I say, and then we sail!
levels.outcome: Everyone is aboard. Set sail for Market Street!

levels.title: Fruit Market
levels.subtitle: Market Street · Unit 3
levels.story: The picnic is coming. First, some fruit!
levels.outcome: Our fruit basket is ready. Let us help at the stall!
levels.hello: Here is your basket! Listen, and put the fruit I say in the basket.

levels.title: Fruit Stall
levels.subtitle: Market Street · Unit 3
levels.story: The stall is empty. Fill the shelf with fruit!
levels.hello: The fruit stall is empty! Put the fruit I say on the shelf.
levels.outcome: The fruit shelf is full. Time to visit the grocery shop!

levels.title: Grocery Shop
levels.subtitle: Market Street · Unit 3
levels.story: Shop for the picnic. Find the food you hear!
levels.hello: Now let's shop for the picnic. Find the food I say.
levels.outcome: We have the food. Now check the boxes!

levels.title: Counting Boxes
levels.subtitle: Market Street · Unit 3
levels.story: Some boxes have the wrong amount! Count the food, then pack each box.
levels.hello: First, count the food and tap the number. Then pack the box: tap the food, then tap the box!
levels.outcome: The right quantities are packed. On to the kitchen!

levels.title: Fruit Kitchen
levels.subtitle: Market Street · Unit 3
levels.story: Make a fruit plate. Swipe to slice!
levels.hello: Let's make a fruit plate! Slice the fruit I say.
levels.outcome: Our fruit plate is ready. Meet everyone at the picnic!

levels.title: Picnic Time
levels.subtitle: Market Street · Unit 3
levels.story: Bring the food you hear to the picnic!
levels.hello: Picnic time! Bring the food I say to the table.
levels.outcome: The picnic is ready. Thank you for helping everyone!
